snippet: The village of 1,000 people, located south of Carcassonne, was struck by a violent tornado on Monday, August 24. Although only around 50 people were injured, nearly two-thirds of the village's 500 houses suffered severe damage.

title: Dolly Parton Chose Her Funeral Song More Than a Decade Ago & Left an Unreleased Song to Be Heard in 2046
